password.setBody: Your account was created with Google or a passkey. Set a password to also log in with email and password.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.off: Add a second step to your login with an authenticator app (TOTP).
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.backupBody: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Log in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkeys.failed: The passkey was not saved. Try again.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.label: Private profile
privacy.help: Your ratings stay in the community scores, but your profile and lists are hidden from other users.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Your account is deleted 30 days after you confirm. Until then you can log in and cancel.
delete.dialogBody: You will be logged out now. If you do not log in and cancel within 30 days, your personal data is erased for good. Your ratings remain in the community scores as an anonymous user.

banner.text: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}.

actions.unauthorized: Your session expired. Log in again.
actions.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
actions.bot: Your request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
actions.passwordAlreadySet: This account already has a password.
actions.weakPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
actions.notScheduled: This account is not scheduled for deletion.
actions.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed.
actions.typeMismatch: This list only accepts items of its own category.
actions.limit: You reached the limit for this.
actions.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
